text:
maya: Quick sync — Product asked us to support an embedding dim bump for rerank customers. Need PRD + launch criteria by EOW. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/emb-dim-change (WIP).

sam: What's the minimal compatibility surface? Can we do shape-preserving aliasing or must customers re-ingest indexes?

li: Customers expect stable vectors. If dims change we need either a mapping layer or full reindex. Mapping layer is cheaper but risky for quality.

alex: Proposed options: 1) pad/truncate + normalization shim, 2) background reindex with versioned index, 3) expose both model variants and let customers choose. Need tradeoffs.

jasmin: Acceptance criteria (draft):
- zero-panic fallback to old model for live rerank :thumbsup:
- p99 latency delta < 100ms for rerank endpoints
- no silent accuracy regression > 2% (NDCG or chosen metric) across customer eval sets

maya: Also define batch semantics: batching must be homogenous by embedding version/dim. Runtime should reject mixed-dim batches or convert them explicitly.

sam: Runtime note: we could add a "model-compat" service that applies pad/trim + per-batch normalization automatically. Perf hit looks like ~+10% in microbenchmarks.

li: Edge case: streaming rerank where parts of a batch are from different dims (or streaming clients switch mid-stream). Proposal: disallow cross-dim streaming and force non-streaming fallback with clear error code and client docs.

alex: Can we make L2-normalization an explicit toggle? Some customers use magnitude info for rerank, others rely on normalized cosine similarity.

jasmin: Add acceptance test: simulate 768 -> 1024 dim change, run rerank eval (NDCG) on internal and 2 customer dev sets; shim must keep drop < 1.5% otherwise fail gate.

deploy-bot: PR opened by @li: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4825 — CI failing one flaky test (investigating).

maya: Roadmap decision: mark this as high priority for Q2 release but gated: (1) PRD signed off, (2) perf regression <5% in prod-like tests, (3) 2 enterprise customers consent to migration plan.

sam: Rollout plan to add to PRD: canary 5% traffic for 48h, auto rollback on NDCG regression threshold, staged reindex option for enterprise customers, customer opt-in for self-serve.

li: I'll draft the RFC/PRD update and post tomorrow morning. Owners: @maya (product), @jasmin (metrics), @sam (runtime).

maya: Quick strawpoll — who objects to pad/truncation shim as default for self-serve? alex: I object (vote no).

alex: I prefer background reindex for enterprise customers; shim is fine for short-term dev comfort but risky at scale.

jasmin: +1 reindex for enterprise; shim as transition path for self-serve. Document in PRD.

sam: Noted. I'll create the acceptance-criteria issue and perf test matrix after the RFC lands.
